Yes, this works the way I'd want. Clicking the title "My PARA reference" opens the original page in a new tab, and my bookmark collection stays put in its own tab — so I can go read the page and still have my whole list waiting for me when I come back. That's important; I wouldn't want opening a link to navigate me away from my collection.

I also like that the title being the clear, underlined link makes it obvious what to click, and that the read-later button and the "•••" menu are their own separate controls sitting apart — so clicking to open the page doesn't accidentally trip one of those. This feels right. Show me the whole-card version and I'll compare.
